title: A China Tech Report Card
text:
A China Tech Report Card

Arthur Kroeber, AJ Cortese, Tom Hancock

Gavekal Technologies: Briefing | 9 Sep 2026

Over the past year Gavekal Technologies has tracked China’s progress across a range of tech sectors. Today we take a step back and try to assess its overall capabilities. We come to three main conclusions. First, outside a handful of areas—mainly in new energy and electricity—China is still more of a fast follower than a global pace-setter. Second, China’s well-documented manufacturing dominance is mainly in products of medium or low complexity. It is catching up in highly complex products, but the rate of progress is slower. Finally, for all the talk in Beijing about the need for self-sufficiency, China’s tech ecosystem still relies heavily on foreign-sourced components, equipment and intellectual property. This is not a weakness but a strength: tight integration with global tech value chains is a key element in China’s ability to keep innovating.Also in this issue of China Tech Brief:
